why_two_are_required: J1 P016-P003 removes the complete calibration cartridge from the Long Run without opening the cartridge.
J2 P003-P007 opens the cartridge to service P006/P008/B001/P013.
With current rear-assembly topology, eliminating either J1 or J2 removes one of those service functions or requires major redesign.
architecture_decision.common_philosophy: Both joints use metal-to-metal axial seating + precision pilot + static elastomer face seal + clamp screws. Fasteners do not locate.
architecture_decision.not_identical: Seal diameter, screw size and bolt circle differ because the functional openings and available envelopes differ.

J1_P016_P003.pilot: P016 Ø10 H7 ×3.20 / P003 Ø10 g6 ×3.00; diametral clearance 0.005..0.029 mm
J1_P016_P003.seal: 12×1.5 static axial O-ring baseline; compound release OPEN
J1_P016_P003.clamp: 3× M4×10 A4-70 baseline, PCD24/120°, ~7 mm nominal engagement through 3 mm P003 flange
J1_P016_P003.clocking: A face + B central pilot + C relieved/diamond locator

J2_P003_P007.pilot: P003 male Ø16 g6 ×1.50 / P007 female Ø16 H7 ×1.70; 0.20 axial end clearance
J2_P003_P007.seal: static axial face O-ring, 1.5-mm cross-section philosophy; exact ISO3601 ring/gland to be frozen after CAD envelope check; FKM/FFKM compound depends gas compatibility
J2_P003_P007.clamp: 3× M3×8 A4-70, PCD28/120°, P007 clearance Ø3.4, P003 M3-6H full engagement ~5 mm
J2_P003_P007.flanges: OD34 candidate; P003 axial thickness 5; P007 axial thickness 3
J2_P003_P007.reason_3_screws: Three evenly spaced clamps are sufficient for axisymmetric static face seal; pressure load is negligible. Fourth screw adds holes and flange demand without a defined functional benefit.

P006.reason: Ø9.10 relief leaves ~0.85 mm radial metal to measured ~Ø10.8 thread-root envelope; M10 is geometrically incompatible and M11 is non-preferred with too little wall.
P006.service_improvement: Add dedicated pin-spanner feature; exact geometry after service-joint CAD envelope is frozen.
